items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Shostakovich came there and conducted his Fifth Symphony. I was playin’ clarinet.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. Well they couldn’t deal with the profundity of it, number one.
One day this racist - William Schafer was his name - racist conductor of the symphonic band that I played in. Shostakovich came there and conducted his Fifth Symphony. I was playin’ clarinet.
